app.name: Cangze
app.tagline: The AI hub for your Home Assistant

status.hubOffline: Live connection to the hub lost, reconnecting

auth.loginHint: Enter the admin key you chose during setup.

setup.title: Set up Cangze
setup.hint: On first start the container log prints a one-time bootstrap code. Enter it and choose the admin key you will sign in with.
setup.wrongCode: The bootstrap code is wrong. Copy it from the latest container log.
setup.generatedHint: This is the only credential for Cangze and it is shown once. Store it in a password manager.

errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts, try again later
errors.unauthorized: Your session expired, sign in again
errors.empty_target: The target does not match any entity
errors.token_required: A long-lived access token is required

state.unconfigured: Home Assistant is not connected yet
state.disconnected: Lost connection to Home Assistant, reconnecting
state.auth_invalid: Home Assistant rejected the access token

devices.title: Devices
devices.search: Search name, entity id or area
devices.connectHint: Enter your Home Assistant URL and a long-lived access token in Settings.
devices.invalidJson: Service data is not valid JSON

ha.nonAdminHint: This token belongs to a regular user: devices can be controlled, but creating or editing automations, scripts and scenes is disabled.
ha.connectionHint: Cangze talks to Home Assistant over its WebSocket and REST APIs; nothing is installed in HA. Use a dedicated HA user for Cangze.
ha.urlHint: As reachable from the Cangze container, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8123
ha.tokenHint: Create one in HA under Profile → Security → Long-lived access tokens.
ha.tokenKeep: A token is stored ({{hint}}). Leave empty to keep it.
ha.verifyTlsHint: Turn off when HA uses a self-signed certificate.
ha.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect Home Assistant and delete the stored token?

security.networkHint: By default plain HTTP is only accepted from your local network; public clients must use HTTPS.
security.allowPublicHttpHint: Accept unencrypted HTTP requests from public addresses. Only enable this if you fully understand the risk.
security.publicHttpOn: Public HTTP is enabled: your admin key and session travel unencrypted over the internet.
security.publicHttpRisk: Anyone who can reach this host will talk to Cangze without encryption. Your admin key and sign-in session can be intercepted and used to control your home. Use HTTPS instead (see the deployment guide).
security.allowedHostsHint: Add custom names you use to reach Cangze, e.g. hub.example.lan. IP addresses, localhost and .local/.lan names are always accepted.
security.keyChanged: Key changed; other browser sessions were signed out

clients.title: Devices & clients
clients.hint: The mobile app and scripts use device tokens. Pairing with a QR code is easiest; tokens can be revoked at any time.
clients.pairHint: Scan the QR code in the Cangze app or type the pairing code. Each code works once.
clients.name: Name
clients.tokenOnce: The token is shown only once. Copy it now.
clients.revokeConfirm: The device will no longer be able to access Cangze.

about.title: About Cangze
about.privacy: Cangze collects no telemetry. Your data stays in your own data volume.

models.defaultsHint: Used by new sessions. Each session can switch models.
models.utilityHint: Used for titles, context compaction and summaries; a small cheap model works. Empty = chat model.
models.providersHint: Add built-in services (OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Qwen, Gemini, …) or any OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoint (Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio, gateways). Keys are encrypted and never shown again.
models.removeConfirm: Remove this provider and its key? Sessions using it need another model.
models.name: Name
models.apiKeyOptional: Leave empty for local servers such as Ollama.
models.keyKeep: A key is stored; leave empty to keep it.
models.customHint: Enter the base URL and press “Discover models” to read the model list, then set context size, reasoning and vision as needed.

risk.title: Risk & approvals
risk.hint: High-risk actions in sessions pause until you approve them in the UI. Subagent permissions are set in each agent's definition.
risk.confirm: Ask before high-risk actions in sessions
risk.confirmHint: When off, sessions perform these actions directly (not recommended).
risk.config: Changing Home Assistant configuration is high risk

chat.deleteConfirm: Delete this session? The conversation cannot be recovered.
chat.pickOrCreate: Pick a session or start a new one
chat.welcomeText: I can check and control your devices, analyse history, create Home Assistant automations, or set up subagents to watch over things.

suggest.lights: Which lights are on right now?
suggest.dim: Set the living room lights to 30%
suggest.temp: How did the living room temperature change in the last 24 hours?
suggest.automation: Create an automation that turns on the porch light after sunset

chat.placeholder: Message — Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line
chat.placeholderBusy: Replying… your message will join the current turn
chat.noVision: The current model cannot see images
chat.editHint: Editing starts a new branch from this message; the previous replies stay in the old branch.
chat.noModels: No models yet — add a provider in Settings
chat.instructionsHint: Standing instructions for this session, such as preferences or things to watch out for.
chat.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. Keep answers short; bedroom lights never above 30% at night.
chat.compactHint: Summarize older messages to free context. Happens automatically near the limit.
chat.noModelConfigured: No default model yet. Add a model provider first.
